generated_examples.rule: Each source row becomes one research-only example with the same official URL, fact, gate and confidence. No parcel relation, planning decision, appeal outcome, permission validity, remaining capacity or Future Growth score is inferred.

second_pass_examples.rule: Each source row is rendered a second time as a fail-closed control. Dataset/code/appeal-route/register presence remains separate from exact current application/decision/permission and parcel-level evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The national planning-application dataset last collected/newly found data in September 2025.
extra_examples.gate: Use the live LPA register for current 2026 case status; national dataset presence is discovery/context only.

extra_examples.fact: The planning-decision dataset has zero collected records and no collection attempt.
extra_examples.gate: Zero records cannot be converted into 'no decision'; authoritative decision notices or PINS/LPA casework remain required.

extra_examples.fact: Planning-application status codes exist even though the platform dataset has no collected status records.
extra_examples.gate: A controlled vocabulary is not a live event stream.

extra_examples.fact: Permission status distinguishes permissioned, not-permissioned and pending-decision.
extra_examples.gate: Never collapse pending-decision into permissioned or use it as a probability of approval.

extra_examples.fact: A planning condition record can contain requirements that constrain implementation.
extra_examples.gate: Condition existence is not proof it remains outstanding; exact discharge/compliance evidence is required.

extra_examples.fact: The Article 4 dataset includes data from 101 providers and some MHCLG-created data.
extra_examples.gate: No platform hit cannot be treated as no Article 4 restriction.

extra_examples.fact: Article 4 area geography identifies affected areas but directions can contain specific rules and dates.
extra_examples.gate: Exact area overlap still requires the live direction/rule before concluding permitted-development rights are removed.

extra_examples.fact: The authoritative brownfield register is intended to identify suitable previously developed sites with development potential.
extra_examples.gate: Register inclusion is not consent, title control, availability or remaining unit capacity.

extra_examples.fact: The brownfield-site boundary dataset is experimental and has only five providers.
extra_examples.gate: Do not use an experimental polygon to overwrite an authoritative register/site-plan boundary.

extra_examples.fact: The roadmap describes development of an initial planning-decision specification in 2026.
extra_examples.gate: Specification work does not mean authoritative national decision data is live.

extra_examples.fact: The new procedural guide applies to applications submitted on or after 1 April 2026.
extra_examples.gate: Choose appeal procedure using the exact application date; do not apply new rules retroactively.

extra_examples.fact: The legacy procedural guide applies to applications dated on or before 31 March 2026.
extra_examples.gate: Application date, not appeal-search date, selects the procedural guide.

extra_examples.fact: March 2026 s78 written-representation decisions had a 16-week median, but PINS warns latest-month data can include much older cases.
extra_examples.gate: Do not forecast a specific appeal decision date from aggregate historical medians.

extra_examples.fact: The Appeals Casework Portal supports searching/commenting on Planning Inspectorate cases.
extra_examples.gate: Portal/search capability is not evidence that a target application has an appeal.

extra_examples.fact: A S106B appeal concerns modification or discharge of a planning obligation.
extra_examples.gate: An obligation appeal does not itself grant, renew or implement the underlying planning permission.

extra_examples.fact: `appeal-granted` is a controlled status code.
extra_examples.gate: Assign only after authoritative PINS/LPA evidence identifies the exact appeal and outcome.

extra_examples.fact: The data model explicitly includes an `expired` application status.
extra_examples.gate: Expired permission/application evidence cannot be counted as live capacity unless a newer permission supersedes it.

extra_examples.fact: `decision-appealed` is distinct from `appeal-granted` and `appeal-refused`.
extra_examples.gate: An appealed decision has no inferred appeal outcome until authoritative determination evidence exists.

extra_examples.fact: Planning officer is a decision-maker category in the data model.
extra_examples.gate: Who made the decision is separate from whether permission was granted or refused.

extra_examples.ref: Secretary of State decision type gate
extra_examples.fact: Secretary of State is a controlled decision-maker category.
extra_examples.gate: A Secretary of State route is not evidence of approval, refusal, call-in or appeal success without the exact decision.

extra_examples.fact: The 2026 register shows 57 dwellings and pending-decision status with a note that application 20/2096 is pending S106.
extra_examples.gate: Do not promote until the live planning register/S106 and final decision state are verified.

extra_examples.fact: The register describes an outline application for up to 108 apartments.
extra_examples.gate: Application quantum is not permissioned capacity until a current decision exists.

extra_examples.fact: The record is end-dated and says the site is no longer considered available and achievable.
extra_examples.gate: Reject from current candidate promotion unless superseded by newer authoritative evidence.

extra_examples.fact: The record describes historic partial completion/stall and has a 23 February 2026 end date.
extra_examples.gate: Historic headline dwelling capacity is not current remaining capacity.

extra_examples.fact: The register shows outline permission for 469 apartments.
extra_examples.gate: Outline status does not prove reserved matters, conditions, commencement or full remaining quantum.

extra_examples.fact: The register notes a historical conversion permission and a valid 2026 application.
extra_examples.gate: Newest authoritative application/decision state takes precedence over older permission assumptions.

extra_examples.fact: The register notes part of the small site is residential garden and not previously developed land.
extra_examples.gate: Do not treat the entire site area as brownfield without exact geometry/site-plan reconciliation.

extra_examples.fact: The register is not-permissioned but notes pending consideration of application 25/00121/FUL.
extra_examples.gate: A pending application note is not permission or a current decision; recheck the live authority register.
